standardization: For each stratum, use its fraction among all5000 as a common weight for the two partition-specific mean adapter-minus-base effects. Report adjusted gap selected-minus-remaining, unadjusted gap and arithmetic difference; no percentage causal explanation.

bootstrap.question_sampling: Independent within each fixed stratum and partition. Preserve allfive model responses per sampled question.
bootstrap.seed_sampling: Shared five-seed bootstrap across all strata and both partitions, after paired question resampling.
bootstrap.conditional_scope: Treat observed stratum weights and partition sizes as fixed; no selection correction or benchmark-selection uncertainty.

no_overlap_rule: If any stratum lacks either partition, report this standardization not identifiable; do not drop the stratum or change grouping.
scope: Outcome-triggered descriptive extension. Coarse type/level adjustment cannot identify adaptive selection bias or eliminate unmeasured within-stratum content/difficulty differences. Uses only frozen primary allfive; no new training, model selection, primary test or efficacy criterion.
